local_controls.procedure: Match contract obligation and accepted event to invoice and journal; separately reconcile deferred/unbilled amounts. Advisory hours may support cost but never substitute for accepted outcomes.
local_controls.evidence: contracts; acceptance; invoices; receipts; journal; AR/deferred rollforwards

local_controls.procedure: Age by contractual due date; distinguish dispute/late payment from missing invoice; retain approved credit-loss and write-off rationale.
local_controls.evidence: invoice due dates; receipts; disputes; aging; allowance estimate

local_controls.procedure: Reconcile mineral tonnes and water/chemistry in their own units; retain title, custody, assay, lot lineage, acceptance and host settlement. Hard bypass excludes unavailable recovery.
local_controls.evidence: feed/run; recovered lot; Bedford batch; acceptance; inventory; settlement

local_controls.procedure: Require receiving owner, qualification and maintenance responsibility. Failed/unfinished qualification leaves the item experimental.
local_controls.evidence: project gate; qualification; transfer; asset/custody record

local_controls.procedure: Reconcile authorized billets, occupied positions and paid FTE separately; stable person/position IDs prevent counting dual roles or borrowed staff twice.
local_controls.evidence: employment roster; assignments; contractors; payroll reconciliation

local_controls.owner: Accountable model owner and Finance reviewer
local_controls.procedure: Record source/version/unit/date, range, reason and outcome sensitivity; do not call a conditional forecast a measured historical result.
local_controls.evidence: assumptions; source/master hashes; scenario comparison; estimate review

local_controls.procedure: Exclude superseded financial scope before adding successor rows; reconcile legal entities, seven units, corporate and eliminations. Internal charges must net to zero.
local_controls.evidence: replacement bridge; legal/unit statements; eliminations; funding and allocation bridges

local_controls.procedure: Check tenant/client purpose and source rights before showing detail; deny absent/unresolved entitlement and record reason; no implicit Alexandria raw-source access.
local_controls.evidence: workspace scope; source rights; access decision; export review

local_controls.procedure: Constrain demand by qualified equipment, labor, route and capacity; uranium custody remains gated independently of ordinary inbound availability.
local_controls.evidence: operating plan; service/production rows; qualification and capacity exception

local_controls.frequency: Before substantive work and final variable-fee certification
local_controls.procedure: Approve and preserve baseline/attribution/payout curve separately from delivery; acceptance/review roles remain independent. Variable fee follows certified outcomes and contract cap. See ADV-VAL-01 through ADV-VAL-05.
local_controls.evidence: matter acceptance; versioned value schedule; certification; fee calculation; transfer record
